metadata.question: Does the wind push ash from Sakurajima first east then south, rathar than first south then east after an eruption on May 21, 2015?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need ash/aerosol data for 21 May 2015 and the following few days over Sakurajima, Japan. – MAIAC Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) from MODIS Terra & Aqua (daily, 1 km) is the best native-proxy for volcanic ash plumes. – If MAIAC is empty we fall back to MCD19A2 (identical product, different name) or MOD08_D3 (daily composite, 1 deg) but we will try MAIAC first because of its 1 km resolution. 2. Masking: The question is about ash, so we keep all valid AOD pixels (QA-screened); we do NOT mask clouds because the infrared aerosol retrieval is attempted even near clouds and we want to catch the plume. 3. Logic: – Define two simple downwind boxes: * eastThenSouthBox: rectangle that first extends east, then turns south. * southThenEastBox: rectangle that first extends south, then turns east. – For each box compute mean AOD on 21 May 2015 (eruption day) and 22 May 2015 (next day). – If both boxes have valid pixels (count > 0) we compare the mean AOD: eastThenSouthMean > southThenEastMean → the ash went more east-then-south (answer A: Yes) otherwise → answer B: No – If collection size == 0 → C1 – If after QA masking no valid pixels remain in either box → C2 – If any mean is None/NaN → C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time sakurajima = ee.Geometry.Point([130.657, 31.58]) # volcano crater eastThenSouthBox = sakurajima.buffer(15000).bounds().transform('EPSG:4326') \ .buffer(30000, 0).bounds() # east then south swath southThenEastBox = sakurajima.buffer(15000).bounds().transform('EPSG:4326') \ .buffer(30000, 90).bounds() # south then east swath date = '2015-05-21' next = '2015-05-22' # 2. Data Acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MAIAC_AOD') \ .filterDate(date, next) \ .select('Optical_Depth_047') if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print('No MAIAC images for 21 May 2015.') print('C1') exit() # 3. Processing & Calculation img = col.first() cEast = img.mask(img.gt(0)).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=eastThenSouthBox, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo() cSouth = img.mask(img.gt(0)).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=southThenEastBox, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo() if cEast is None or cSouth is None or (cEast + cSouth) == 0: print('No valid AOD pixels after masking.') print('C2') exit() mEast = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=eastThenSouthBox, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo() mSouth = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=southThenEastBox, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo() # 4. Validation & Answer print(f'Mean AOD east-then-south: {mEast:.2f} (pixels {int(cEast)})') print(f'Mean AOD south-then-east: {mSouth:.2f} (pixels {int(cSouth)})') if mEast is None or mSouth is None: print('C3') elif mEast > mSouth: print('A') else: print('B') ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
sakurajima = ee.Geometry.Point([130.657, 31.58])  # volcano crater
eastThenSouthBox = sakurajima.buffer(15000).bounds().transform('EPSG:4326') \
                            .buffer(30000, 0).bounds()  # east then south swath
southThenEastBox = sakurajima.buffer(15000).bounds().transform('EPSG:4326') \
                            .buffer(30000, 90).bounds()  # south then east swath
date = '2015-05-21'
next = '2015-05-22'

# 2. Data Acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MAIAC_AOD') \
        .filterDate(date, next) \
        .select('Optical_Depth_047')
if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print('No MAIAC images for 21 May 2015.')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')
    exit()

# 3. Processing & Calculation
img = col.first()
cEast = img.mask(img.gt(0)).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                         geometry=eastThenSouthBox, scale=1000,
                                         maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo()
cSouth = img.mask(img.gt(0)).reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                         geometry=southThenEastBox, scale=1000,
                                         maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo()
if cEast is None or cSouth is None or (cEast + cSouth) == 0:
    print('No valid AOD pixels after masking.')
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')
    exit()

mEast = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                         geometry=eastThenSouthBox, scale=1000,
                         maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo()
mSouth = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                          geometry=southThenEastBox, scale=1000,
                          maxPixels=1e9).get('Optical_Depth_047').getInfo()

# 4. Validation & Answer
print(f'Mean AOD east-then-south: {mEast:.2f} (pixels {int(cEast)})')
print(f'Mean AOD south-then-east: {mSouth:.2f} (pixels {int(cSouth)})')

if mEast is None or mSouth is None:
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif mEast > mSouth:
    print('<answer>A</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>B</answer>')
